name: Wynn Resorts
description: Wynn Resorts designs, develops and operates luxury integrated resorts, reporting four segments: Wynn Palace (Cotai, Macau), Wynn Macau (Macau Peninsula), Las Vegas Operations (Wynn Las Vegas/Encore), and Encore Boston Harbor (Massachusetts). Revenue is earned from casino gaming (table games and slots, with a heavy premium/VIP mix in Macau), hotel rooms, food & beverage, retail and entertainment. The company also holds a 40% minority equity interest in Wynn Al Marjan Island, a resort under development in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, expected to open in 2027 — this is a development-stage equity investment, not yet a reported operating segment.

founded.value: 2002 (by Stephen A. Wynn, Elaine P. Wynn and Kazuo Okada)
